info.title: CMS Content API
info.description: Read-only content delivery. This schema snapshot describes one tenant. Unsupported: writes, draft preview, search, filters other than slug, and custom sorting. Translatable fields resolve per ?locale= with fallback to the default language. Assets have stable URLs backed by the CMS disk cache. Astro fetches content at build time; the CMS queues rebuilds through Coolify. Primitive fields pass through stored JSON; x-cms-editorSchema describes expected editor values, not delivery validation.

get.description: Returns a published page or a redirect instruction in a 200 JSON envelope. Your website sends the HTTP 308. Old paths resolve directly to the latest URL; unpublished/deleted targets and unknown paths return 404. Locale defaults to the tenant default and is not inferred from the path.

parameters.description: Must match the tenant associated with the bearer token.

parameters.description: Full website path, including any language/prefix. No trailing slash except /.

get.description: Published, non-deleted root entries ordered by createdAt descending, then id descending. No snapshot guarantee across pages. Expansion budgets: 500 component references, 200 unique assets; rich text traversal budget 2,000 visited values and nesting depth 100. Exceeding a budget returns 400; lower limit or maxDepth, or simplify the document.

parameters.name: tenantSlug
parameters.description: Must match the tenant associated with the bearer token.

parameters.name: modelSlug
parameters.description: A model slug from model discovery or manifest.json.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum entries per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass meta.nextCursor unchanged; stop when null.

parameters.name: maxDepth
parameters.description: Root counts as depth 1; depth-limited and cyclic components remain compact references.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language for translatable fields (x-cms-localized). A field without a translation in this language returns the default-language value. Unknown languages return 400.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Only entries whose slug field equals this value. Translatable slug fields match the slug in the requested locale, falling back to the default-language slug. Hierarchical routing slugs are only unique among siblings; use resolvePage for website routing. Other slugs are unique only when configured so (config.unique).

parameters.name: slugField
parameters.description: Key of the slug field to match. Required only when the model has more than one slug field; unknown keys return 400.

get.summary: Get an asset with a stable media URL
get.description: Returns any ready, non-deleted asset of this tenant with stable url and downloadUrl values. Both serve bytes through the CMS cache and check file access on every request. Store asset IDs as the source of truth; refresh URLs after signing-secret rotation.

contentToken.description: Authorization: Bearer cms_at_<secret>. Use only from a trusted server.

downloadUrl.description: Stable cached file URL. Anyone with this URL can read this specific file until deletion or signing-secret rotation. Access is rechecked on every request.

url.description: Stable cached media URL, identical to downloadUrl. Does not expire on a timer. Access is revoked by deletion or signing-secret rotation.

RichTextNode.description: Expected Tiptap JSON node shape. Raw legacy rich-text values are not validated by delivery. Asset nodes retain attrs.assetId and add attrs.asset (object or null).

data.description: Fields may be absent after model edits. Unknown/stale keys are retained. Raw fields follow editor intent but delivery does not enforce primitive types or enum membership. Validate before rendering.
